# Tab 1
## Data Prep
```{r}
# app inputs
start_month <- yearmonth('2016 Jun')
end_month   <- yearmonth('2026 Oct')  
split_month <- yearmonth('2025 Oct')   
h_months    <- 12                     

dir.create('figures', showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# keeping only unique requests
pothole <- read_csv('data/get_it_done_pothole_requests_datasd.csv', show_col_types = FALSE) |> 
  transmute(
    month = yearmonth(date_requested),
    council_district = factor(council_district),
    is_unique = is.na(service_request_parent_id)
  ) |> 
  filter(month >= start_month, month <= end_month)

# helper function for aggregation
summarise_monthly <- function(data, ...){
  data |> 
    group_by(month, ...) |> 
    summarise(
      requests_unique = sum(is_unique),
      total_reports = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
}
```

```{r}
# monthly by council district
pothole_monthly_district <- pothole |> 
  # 0.16% of requests have no district and will be excluded
  filter(!is.na(council_district)) |> 
  summarise_monthly(council_district) |> 
  as_tsibble(index = month, key = council_district) |> 
  fill_gaps(requests_unique = 0L, total_reports = 0L, .full=TRUE)

# monthly citywide requests 
pothole_monthly <- pothole |> 
  summarise_monthly() |> 
  as_tsibble(index = month) |> 
  fill_gaps(requests_unique = 0L, total_reports = 0L)

# small file for Shiny instead of raw CSV
saveRDS(pothole_monthly_district, 'data/potholes_monthly_district.rds')

pothole_monthly_district
```

```{r}
# train validation split 
train_district <- pothole_monthly_district |> filter(month <= split_month)
valid_district <- pothole_monthly_district |> filter(month > split_month)
```

## Exploration

```{r}
pothole_monthly |>
  autoplot(requests_unique) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date(split_month + 1),
             linetype = 'dashed', linewidth = 0.5, colour = 'orange') +
  labs(
    title    = 'Unique Pothole Requests, Citywide',
    subtitle = 'Dashed line marks the start of the validation period',
    y        = 'Number of unique requests',
    x        = 'Month'
  )
pothole_monthly
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 12

requests_by_council_plot <- pothole_monthly_district |> 
  autoplot(requests_unique) + 
  facet_wrap(~ council_district, ncol = 1, scales = 'free_y') +
  labs(
    title = 'Unique Pothole Requests by Council District',
    y = 'Number of Unique Requests',
    x = 'Month',
    caption = '0.16% of requests had no council district and are excluded'
  ) + 
  theme(legend.position = 'none')

ggsave('figures/requests_by_council.png',
       plot = requests_by_council_plot,
       width = 10, height = 14, dpi = 300)

requests_by_council_plot
```

# Tab 2
## Model Building 

### Fit
```{r}
fit <- train_district |> 
  model(
    TSLM = TSLM(requests_unique ~ trend() + season()),
    ETS = ETS(requests_unique),
    ARIMA = ARIMA(requests_unique)
  ) |> 
  mutate(ENSEMBLE = (ETS + ARIMA) / 2)
```

```{r}
specs_table <- fit |> as_tibble() |> 
  transmute(
    `Council District` = council_district, 
    ETS = map_chr(ETS, model_sum), 
    ARIMA = map_chr(ARIMA, model_sum))

specs_table |> gt()
```

### Training Accuracy
```{r}
acc_train_table <- bind_rows(
  accuracy(fit) |> mutate(window = 'Training')
  ) |> 
  select(council_district, .model, window, RMSE, MAE, MAPE) |> 
  arrange(.model, MAPE)

acc_train_table |> gt()
```

### Forecast Accuracy

```{r}
fc <- fit |> forecast(h = h_months)

acc_val_table <- bind_rows(
  accuracy(fc, pothole_monthly_district) |> mutate(window = 'Validation')
) |> 
  select(council_district, .model, window, RMSE, MAE, MAPE) |> 
  arrange(.model, MAPE)

acc_val_table |> gt()
```


```{r}
acc_tbl <- bind_rows(
  accuracy(fit) |> mutate(window = 'Training'),
  accuracy(fc, pothole_monthly_district) |> mutate(window = 'Validation')
) |>
  select(council_district, .model, window, RMSE, MAE, MAPE) |>
  arrange(council_district, window, RMSE)

acc_tbl
```


```{r}
val_rmse <- acc_tbl |>
  filter(window == 'Validation') |>
  select(council_district, .model, RMSE) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = .model, values_from = RMSE) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(`Best Model` = c('TSLM', 'ETS', 'ARIMA', 'Ensemble')[which.min(c(TSLM, ETS, ARIMA, ENSEMBLE))]) |>
  ungroup()

val_rmse |> gt() |> fmt_number(decimals = 1)
```
